verdict.rationale: A client portal or dashboard showing case status is a fair question for a law firm serving founders, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a portal, dashboard or case-status tracking. The closest items are 'fully managed' service language and a case-assessment intake form, which are adjacent features, not a status view.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see where my case is — a client portal or dashboard with case status and next steps is a documented part of the product
